title: Cloud Build approval was not bound to immutable code

cwe_mappings.note: The source explicitly names a time-of-check/time-of-use vulnerability; numeric CWE mapping is editorial.

summary: A Cloud Build integration report identified a mismatch between maintainer approval and the code ultimately executed; Google awarded $30,000.
root_cause: The approval decision and later code-reference resolution were not bound to the same immutable version, creating a time-of-check/time-of-use flaw.
impact: Unreviewed code could run with the privileges and secrets available to a build. Impact depended on the permissions of the affected pipeline.
defensive_takeaways: Bind approval decisions to immutable content identities.
Validate that the executed revision matches the authorized revision.
Limit build identity privileges and isolate untrusted contributions.
